checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13; p1000 handles 250 uL and mix 400, p300 multi handles volumes ≤200 uL via chunks (180 uL for 540 uL, 167 uL for 500 uL); wells stay under 2.4 mL and reservoir columns within 15 mL (check passed); 34 tip columns fit in the 36 available.

Every pipetting action has a tip and every tip is dropped; check 'fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact' passed with 48 distinct tips; removals and elution recovery use a fresh tip per column; shared reagent tips only dispense at well top(-2) before sample contact.

Order and numbers match the paper: 40 uL beads, 250 uL IPA, 250 uL sample, mix 5x, 5 min, magnet 4 min, two 500 uL ethanol washes, 4 min dry, elute 100 uL, 30 s, magnet 90 s, recover; metadata citation is accurate and all 17 checks passed.
Checks '48_samples_to_odd_columns' and 'distinct_elution_wells' passed; sources rack1+rack2 map one-to-one onto odd-column wells with a fresh p1000 tip each.
Checks binding_volumes_40_250_250, mix_5x_after_sample, incubation_5min_before_magnet, magnet_4min_before_first_removal all passed; mag.engage() then 4 min delay then remove_liquid(540) to waste.
Checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes, magnet_engaged_for_all_removals and air_dry_4min passed; magnet stays engaged through both washes and the 4 min delay, then mag.disengage() before elution.
Checks elution_100ul, elution_off_magnet_then_90s_on, recover_70_100ul_one_well_each and elution_plate_4C_before_recovery passed; 100 uL recovered to its own well of the elution plate.

judge.summary: The protocol passed all 17 measured run-log checks, and the code matches the paper's steps, volumes, timings and tip handling. I found no deviation or unsafe practice, so every item scores 1.
